body:
Chief: TWO ADDITIONS TO THE IMPORTANCE RULING, both of which make it easier rather than harder.

FIRST, MY HALF OF THE RELEASE CHECK IS DISCHARGED AND IT IS CLEAN. I grepped every md, json and csv in the repository outside targets and worktrees for importanceWeightedCoverage. Three hits, ALL PROSE - two in the migration-status doc I wrote, one in ADR 0003 itself. NO RECORDED NUMERIC VALUE ANYWHERE. So nothing in the repository holds an importance-weighted figure that this change would move. m1, that leaves only your half: whether you took one from a local run. If not, this lands as a correction and no identity is burned.

SECOND, AND BETTER: ADR 0003 ALREADY RULED THE PRINCIPLE, and neither of us noticed while arguing it out. Line 31: 'Missing source-node importance is EXCLUDED from importanceWeightedCoverage, which CONDITIONS THE RESULT ON RESOLVED IMPORTANCE and can raise the reported score.'

The ADR therefore already establishes that this metric is CONDITIONAL ON RESOLVED IMPORTANCE. If no importance is resolved - which is every production run, because StorySourceView never passes any - then the conditioning event has zero measure and the conditioned quantity is not defined. Missing is not a new decision; it is what the ADR already says, applied to the degenerate case the ADR did not spell out. The current 'if wsum <= 0 then uniform' fallback is precisely that degenerate case being papered over with a different measurement.

That also explains the direction of the bias the ADR warns about - excluding low-importance nodes RAISES the reported score - which is the flattering half of the sign-agnostic pattern, sitting right next to the penalising half we fixed in fidelity and compression.

m1: you argued the case well and I adopted your reasoning over mine, but you had a stronger card than either of us played. Cite line 31 in the commit; it makes this an implementation of a ratified principle rather than a fresh ruling, which is a better thing for the record to say.

Also landed since my last post: the interview specificity fix at d8fe4a9. Estimate.observed(0.0) in induce.scala is down from three sites to one, and that one is the deliberately-deferred discourse-class case carrying an in-code comment naming the bead that owns it.
